title: Marketing webinar campaign sync - 2025 Q3 Product Launch
summary: Planning sync for Q3 product launch webinar: finalize dates, landing page, speaker logistics, promotional calendar, and rehearsal schedule. Agreed to two rehearsals, partner co-marketing assets due 6/24, and registration target of 1,200 signups.
topics: Landing page copy and registration flow
Promotional calendar (email, paid social, partner co-marketing)
next_steps: Sophie to share final slide deck and speaker bios (link) by 2025-06-23
Jordan to book studio/rehearsal slots and send calendar invites by 2025-06-22
Marco & Liam to publish promotional calendar and ad creative by 2025-06-24
Priya to finalize landing page copy and registration form by 2025-06-24
Partners (Eva / Samir) to share co-marketing assets and logos by 2025-06-24
action_items: Sophie: finalize slide deck + speaker one-pager (due 2025-06-23)
Jordan: reserve rehearsal studio and set up tech checklist (due 2025-06-22)
Marco: launch paid social creative and tracking pixels (due 2025-06-24)
Liam: email cadence and segmentation plan (due 2025-06-24)
Priya: landing page copy + registration form QA (due 2025-06-24)
Partners (Eva / Samir): provide headshots, short bios, and co-marketing blurb (due 2025-06-24)
meeting_header: Date: 2025-06-20 | Time: 14:00 - 14:54 PT | Duration: 54 minutes | Attendees: Sophie, Liam, Jordan, Priya, Marco, Eva, Samir
transcript:
[00:00] Sophie: Okay, uh, good afternoon everyone, thanks for joining. We'll give it a minute for stragglers but wanted to kick off. This is the Q3 product-launch webinar planning sync, quick run of show and then action items.
[00:15] Liam: Hey, Sophie, I'm in, sorry I'm a bit late, cabling issues on my end.
[00:22] Jordan: Yep all good, logging in now.
[00:28] Sophie: Cool. Quick agenda: confirm date, speakers, rehearsal dates, landing page copy, promo calendar, and metrics. Also partners — Eva and Samir are on for partner promo.
[00:40] Eva: Hi all, excited to be here. We have bandwidth to amplify with one dedicated email and social post from Acme.
[00:45] Samir: Same from CloudCo, we'll push to partner newsletter as well, just need the blurb.
[00:52] Priya: Great — I can draft the partner blurb today and share in the doc.
[00:56] Sophie: Ok first, date. Proposed 2025-07-15 at 10am PT. Any conflicts?
[01:03] Marco: that works from my side. 10am has higher attendance historically, so thumbs up.
[01:08] Liam: Works for me too.
[01:10] Eva: good for Acme.
[01:12] Sophie: Great locked then — I'll send calendar invite after. Next, run of show — 60 minutes total: 10 min intros, 30 min product demo + use cases, 15 min panel discussion, 5 min CTA + Q&A. Thoughts?
[01:28] Jordan: 60 seems right. We should plan a tech-check 30 minutes before and a dry run the day before.
[01:34] Priya: Could we tighten demo to 25 and give 20 to panel? Last time panel went heavy and cut into Q&A.
[01:40] Sophie: Hmm, ok maybe demo 25 / panel 20 / Q&A 10 — that gives more audience time.
[01:47] Marco: I'm fine with that. Also recommend we set up a moderator for live q's so speakers aren't fielding everything.
[01:53] Liam: I'll moderate.
[01:55] Sophie: Perfect. Speaker logistics: we have internal product: Alex and Tina (product leads) — Alex will do demo. Panelists — Eva (Acme) and Samir (CloudCo), and Marco suggested inviting a customer success story but we don't have one locked.
[02:12] Marco: I can reach out to a customer (Nexus) they might be open.
[02:17] Priya: I need bios and headshots by Tuesday for the landing page.
[02:21] Eva: I'll send mine and a short bio later today.
[02:24] Samir: same.
[02:26] Sophie: Slide deck — goal is a single 20 slide deck: 6 slides product story, 8 demo screenshots / flows, 4 panel prompts, 2 CTA and next steps. Priya can help with slide copy.
[02:38] Priya: Yup I'll refine the copy and align tone with the campaign.
[02:41] Liam: Quick note on screenshots — Alex, please provide high-res assets and also a short script for the demo steps so we can create the animated GIFs for ads.
[02:52] Alex (not on call) - noted in Slack. [this line indicates Alex confirmed offline]
[02:57] Sophie: Landing page — we want minimal fields: name, company, email, role, and checkbox for cal follow-up. Also include a downloadable 'one-pager' after webinar.
[03:09] Priya: I'll draft the form. Can we add UTM options for paid channels?
[03:13] Marco: definitely. Need to map paid ad landing URLs to our attribution.
[03:17] Jordan: Also plan for double opt-in? Legal asked about consent on partner lists.
[03:21] Sophie: Good flag — legal, we should default to single opt-in but partners must confirm their lists are opted-in. Partners will confirm.
[03:29] Eva: Acme will only send to opted-in users, yes.
[03:32] Samir: CloudCo same, we'll attach a co-marketing agreement snippet.
[03:35] Sophie: Promo calendar — two-week paid + org email send cadence: pre-announce, one week out, 3 days out, 1 day out, and day-of reminder. Marco and Liam will own paid and owned channels respectively.
[03:48] Marco: For paid we recommend dynamic creatives, 3 variants A/B, and a CPL target of $25. We'll start spend 7 days out and ramp.
[03:57] Liam: For email segmentation: target product trial users, platform newsletter, and partners. Sequence templates will be in Notion.
[04:07] Priya: Copy needs to be punchy, mention latency and cost benefits but don't be too technical. Use a customer-first hook.
[04:14] Sophie: Agreed — avoid deep infra talk; highlight 'predictable inference at scale' as the headline.
[04:20] Jordan: Tech check — platform: we'll stream via StreamCast, need to test mic, sim latency, and screen share with Alex. Also confirm recording permissions.
[04:29] Sophie: We'll enable recording and send recording to registrants. Also schedule captions; auto captions are ok but need manual QA post.
[04:36] Eva: Will partners be on-stage? We assume panel.
[04:38] Sophie: Yes, panelists on-stage for their 20 minutes. We'll give them 3 prompt questions ahead of time.
[04:44] Samir: can we see those prompts?
[04:46] Priya: I'll draft prompts and share by EOD today.
[04:49] Liam: KPI targets — registration 1,200, live attendance 25% of registrants, conversion to trial 5% of live, and NPS target 40. Is that realistic?
[04:59] Marco: 1,200 seems aggressive but doable with partners and paid. If we get 1,200 reg and 300 live that's 25% which is typical.
[05:06] Sophie: Ok we'll aim for that but set internal thresholds: green = 1,200, yellow = 800.
[05:12] Jordan: Rehearsal schedule — tech check 30 min before live, full dry run 7/14 (day before) at 10am PT, and a quick run with Alex + panel 7/11 for flow.
[05:24] Priya: I noted that.
[05:26] Sophie: Promo assets — need hero image, 3 social sizes, short teaser video 15s, and 30s cut. Marco to coordinate creative.
[05:35] Marco: We'll reuse some existing product footage but need new captions and callouts.
[05:39] Liam: For tracking, add UTM_CAMPAIGN=webinar_q3, and a unique landing token for partners.
[05:46] Jordan: Also confirm the thank-you email has the link to add to calendar and calendar ICS.
[05:50] Priya: I'll add that to the template.
[05:52] Sophie: Questions from partners?
[05:54] Eva: One ask — can we co-brand the registration page minimally? We prefer the partner logo above fold and a partner blurb.
[06:01] Sophie: Yes we can include partner logos and blurb under host banner. Jordan will add placement.
[06:06] Samir: Also, can we get a short 1-paragraph case study highlight to include on the landing page?
[06:11] Marco: If Nexus confirms, we can do a 2-3 sentence highlight.
[06:15] Sophie: Budget — Marco, do you need any pre-approval?
[06:18] Marco: No, small paid spend within marketing budget; if we exceed $10k I'll flag.
[06:23] Liam: Legal/compliance — need to add SSO invite to internal training? not relevant here I think.
[06:29] Sophie: Ok not needed. But ensure partners sign co-marketing terms.
[06:33] Priya: Assets and copy deadlines recapped: partner assets, slides, bios due 6/24.
[06:38] Jordan: I'll set rehearsal invites and booking now.
[06:41] Sophie: Great. Any other blockers?
[06:44] Eva: none. Samir: none.
[06:46] Sophie: Recap: date 7/15 10am PT; deliverables due 6/24; rehearsals 7/11 and 7/14; targets 1,200 regs. Sophie will share slide deck by 6/23. Jordan to send invites. Marco/Liam/Priya will share promo calendar and landing page.
[06:59] Liam: I'll draft the email sequence and upload to Notion.
[07:03] Priya: I'll post landing page copy in the doc and flag CTA language.
[07:07] Jordan: Recording will be turned on and auto-captions, I'll check StreamCast settings.
[07:12] Sophie: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up in Slack with the links. Meeting adjourned.
[07:16] [End of recording]
